    """Extract ``model string б· family`` from policy ``[models]``.

    Families: ``sol | v4 | k3 | legacy``. Raises ``RuntimeError`` when a pin

    models = policy.get("models", {})
    mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
    for key, family in (("sol_model", "sol"), ("v4_model", "v4"),
                        ("k3_model", "k3")):
        name = str(models.get(key, "")).strip()
        if not name:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "policy [models].%s missing бк meter attribution requires "
                "explicit model pins (fail closed)" % key)
        mapping[name.lower()] = family
    for alias in models.get("legacy_aliases", []):

        monotonic within a task; downward transitions require the cooldown to

                          BudgetState.BREAK: self.break_at}

                doc["state_changed_at"] = utc_now()

                            {"from": current.value, "to": target.value,

            unused = max(0, allocated - consumed)

                        {"agent_id": agent_id, "tokens": unused})

        result["errors"] = errors
